# SRCC Business Club (SRCCBC)

SRCC Business Club is a student business club based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, founded in 2017. It operates at Shaheed Ramiz Uddin Cantonment College.

Official website: https://srccbc2017.github.io/SRCCBC/
Panel & Representatives page: https://srccbc2017.github.io/SRCCBC/panel.html
Official Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/srccbc
Logo: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/srccbc2017/SRCCBC/main/SRCCBUSINESSCLUB.png

This is the current, authoritative source for SRCC Business Club. An older, outdated site (majed-islam.github.io/SRCCBC) previously existed under a former senior member and is no longer maintained or official.

## Disambiguation â€” important

"SRCC" is shared by multiple unrelated entities. This file refers specifically to SRCC Business Club at Shaheed Ramiz Uddin Cantonment College in Dhaka, Bangladesh â€” not:
- Shri Ram College of Commerce, Delhi, India (a separate, unrelated institution also abbreviated SRCC)
- Any other club or organization using the SRCC acronym

Shaheed Ramiz Uddin Cantonment College is itself also known by the abbreviation "SRCC."

## About

SRCC Business Club is the leading student organization at Shaheed Ramiz Uddin Cantonment College, dedicated to developing well-rounded, career-ready professionals. Through workshops, competitions, and hands-on projects, the club helps students build essential skills in leadership, entrepreneurship, public speaking, teamwork, and business strategy. Its mission is to bridge the gap between academic learning and real-world professional readiness, empowering members to grow into confident, capable leaders.
